training.preview_note: Real model and selected Evolution. Preview never attacks the arena.
training.drag_help: Drag the model to rotate. Scroll to zoom.
training.local_note: Local trial: neutral Arcanas, no Shop, tower fire, rating or rewards.
training.difficulty_note: Easy, Medium and Hard use normal resources. Impossible gives only the local bot twice the Energy regeneration.
training.measurement_note: Actual HP changes; overheal and shield absorption are separate. Time advances only while the trial runs.
training.limit: Safety limit reached · Reset to continue
training.summon_note: Summoned by an ability; preview only.
unit.shieldbearer.lore: The gatehouse sent its last shield to the BattleLine. Its bearer intends to bring both the shield and the army home.
unit.archer.lore: Archer learned to read the wind between the island pines. Behind a steady front line, each arrow finds its own path.
unit.bone_brute.lore: Old armor was built to contain this giant. Now the armor follows as Bone Brute marches through the dust of another age.
unit.hexer.lore: Hexer keeps a winter in the folds of its robe. Wherever its staff points, the enemy advance begins to wither.
unit.sawbot.lore: The workshop sharpened Sawbot for a narrow passage. War offered a much larger corridor.
unit.siege_walker.lore: Siege Walker counts the distance to the far gate in heavy footsteps. Its crew trusts the patient arc of every shot.
unit.bloomkeeper.lore: Bloomkeeper carries a small spring through the battleground. Even the longest march leaves room for something to grow again.
unit.rootcaller.lore: The ground remembers Rootcaller. Beneath the lane, old roots wait for the familiar knock of its staff.
unit.nester.lore: Nester shelters the hive beneath a traveling canopy. A quiet moment is often the beginning of another small march.
unit.rampart.lore: Rampart was assembled from the walls nobody thought worth saving. It now makes those walls useful one last time.
unit.beetling.lore: A leaf shakes and a Beetling joins the column. Its place in the hive is small; its determination is not.
unit.longaxe.lore: Longaxe marks a wide circle in the dust before every battle. The circle is a warning, not a boundary.
unit.farwatch.lore: Farwatch once kept the coast road safe from the tower roof. The horizon is closer now, but the watch continues.
unit.bombard.lore: Bombard brings the workshop thunder to the front. Every heavy shell is an answer to a crowded enemy line.
unit.rotcap.lore: Rotcap carries the forest floor beneath its bright cap. Those who brush past it discover how far a spore can travel.
unit.old_finn.lore: Old Finn has outlasted many banners and remembers every tune. His staff keeps time for a march that refuses to hurry.
unit.antidote_brewer.lore: Antidote Brewer knows what grows beside every poisoned stream. Its flask carries the answer back to the army.
unit.shatterback.lore: Each plate on Shatterback has survived a different siege. The last thing an enemy should want is to break another one.
unit.blood_furnace.lore: Blood Furnace moves with the heat of an unfinished ritual. Its crew measures the price of every exchange in red sparks.
unit.bloodweaver.lore: Bloodweaver threads a crimson path through the battle. What the enemy loses may become another chance for an ally.
unit.oilpress.lore: Oilpress rolls forward under a patient weight of iron. Where it stops, the front line learns to hold.
unit.drumguard.lore: Drumguard remembers the heartbeat of a distant parade. One companion at a time, the rhythm turns the march into a promise.
unit.leechroot.lore: Leechroot takes no trophy from the battlefield. Every fallen foe becomes another ring in its patient growth.
unit.cargo_crab.lore: Cargo Crab has carried supplies through tides and sieges. It treats an allied passenger as its most important delivery.
unit.puppetmaster.lore: Puppetmaster never needs to raise its voice. A slight pull on the strings can change the company an enemy keeps.
unit.smuggler.lore: Smuggler knows a side road to every battlefield. The next crate always arrives with fewer questions than its contents deserve.
unit.crate.lore: A sealed shipment left behind the advancing column. Its contents belong to whoever can reach it.
training.drill.micro: Rank 1; expires after 12.0s; fuses with another Microdrill
training.drill.double: Rank 2; expires after 14.0s; fuses with another Duodrill
training.no_special: No additional special ability in this form.
